description.text:
A special Scarlet & Violet set released on 17 January 2025, with 131 cards plus secret rares, about Eevee and its evolutions, each of which appears as a Stellar Tera Pokémon ex, with many special illustration rares whose artwork is found only in this set. Its products came out through 2025, from Elite Trainer Boxes in January to booster bundles in March and a Super-Premium Collection in May.

No English booster boxes were made, which added to the scarcity of its packs, and collectors' demand for its cards led to scalping and repeated stock-outs.

description.text: The Champion copy of Friends in Paldea, stamped for the winner of a Professor Cup. Professor Cups are fun-format tournaments held through the year for Pokémon Professors, usually those at Stage 1 and above. Friends in Paldea replaced Community Center as the Professor Cup promo from the 2025-26 season, which also brought a new Finalist stamp for the runner-up in each game (card game, Pokémon GO and video game); Top 8, Top 4 and Champion copies were given too.
